definition: Simulates Heat-Tolerant Wheat Programs operating for a day.

title: Heat-Tolerant Wheat Programs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Heat-Tolerant Wheat Programs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Heat-Tolerant Wheat Programs — wheat for a hotter world.

Phase 1 — Prove (heat traits): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (breeding speed): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (yield stability): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and farms-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
